shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la samples/ && find samples -type f -not -path '*/.*' | sort && ls -la reports 2>/dev/null
cd <WORKSPACE>/samples && for f in $(find . -type f | sort); do printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$f" "$(stat -f %z "$f")" "$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' ')" "$(file -b "$f")"; done
cd <WORKSPACE>/samples && for f in docs/*.txt docs/*.md web/*.html data/crate-types.json; do echo "=== $f"; head -n 15 "$f" | cut -c1-200; done

cd <WORKSPACE>/samples && for f in data/deliveries.csv logs/coldstore.log logs/sync.log; do echo "=== $f"; head -n 8 "$f" | cut -c1-200; done; echo; grep -n -i -E 'title|author|date|autor|fecha|datum|verfasser|erstellt|von:|<title|<meta' docs/* web/* data/* logs/* 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-200 | head -8

cd <WORKSPACE>/samples && stat -f '%N	%z' data/crate-types.json data/deliveries.csv docs/betriebsanleitung.txt docs/informe-de-cosecha.txt docs/meeting-notes.md docs/rapport-trimestriel.txt logs/coldstore.log logs/sync.log web/contacto.html web/price-list.html && wc -l data/crate-types.json data/del

head -n 15 docs/betriebsanleitung.txt docs/informe-de-cosecha.txt docs/meeting-notes.md docs/rapport-trimestriel.txt | cut -c1-200; echo ====; head -n 15 web/contacto.html web/price-list.html | cut -c1-200; echo ====; head -c 600 data/crate-types.json; echo; echo ====; head -n 8 data/deliveries.csv

head -n 15 web/contacto.html | cut -c1-200; echo "-- price-list"; head -n 18 web/price-list.html | cut -c1-200; echo "-- crate-types"; head -c 600 data/crate-types.json; echo; echo "-- deliveries"; head -n 8 data/deliveries.csv | cut -c1-200

head -n 8 logs/coldstore.log | cut -c1-200; echo "-- sync"; head -n 8 logs/sync.log | cut -c1-200; echo "-- rest of docs"; sed -n '1,4p' docs/betriebsanleitung.txt | cut -c1-120 >/dev/null; grep -n -i -E 'author|autor|auteur|date|fecha|datum|titel|title' docs/*.txt docs/*.md web/* data/* logs/* | cu

grep -n -o -E '20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' docs/* web/* data/* logs/* | sort -u | head -40; echo "-- secret-like scan:"; grep -n -i -E 'password|passwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key|BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE' docs/* web/* data/* logs/* || echo none; echo "-- coldstore last lines"; tail -n 3 logs/coldstore.l
